matt: Hey team — replied to review comments on #4721 and pushed fixes. PTAL when you have a sec; we need to merge before tomorrow's release window. Quick notes:
- fixed NPE in allocator on cold-start
- added unit + e2e for shard fallback
- tweaked API response shape (minor): previously single `result` -> now `items` list (compat handled)
I kept commits separate to preserve history; can squash if you'd prefer. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4721

caroline: Thanks — can you paste the exact git range or the new commit messages? I want to skim the API change only (short on time).

matt: Sure: `git fetch origin && git log --oneline origin/main..feature/shard-fallback --pretty=format:%h	%s --reverse` ->
``
3a9f2b1	fix: allocator null-check on cold path
8b4c7e2	test: add e2e for shard fallback
5d2a6c9	feat(api): return items[] wrapper with legacy flag
``

sarah: If tests pass, I prefer squash for release branches. Keeps the changelog clean. Also add a short changelog entry in the PR body.

jiayi: PTAL shortly. Two quick q's: 1) is the API change backward compatible for existing clients? 2) do we need a migration plan?

matt: 1) It's additive — server still supports legacy single-result by default when `X-Compat: legacy` header is present. 2) No migration required; added a compatibility test at `server/tests/test_api_compat.py`. CI is green: https://ci.internal/4500/build/987 (all checks passed).

caroline: OK reading now. If CI is green and tests cover the compat case, squash is fine by me. Please include the changelog bullet and mention the `X-Compat` header in the PR description.

release-bot: Reminder: release window reserved 2026-03-19 09:00-10:00 UTC. Merge cutoff 2026-03-19 07:30 UTC.

matt: Thanks — plan: squash into one commit, update PR description + changelog entry, then assign back to @caroline for final merge. Will ping again in ~15m.

caroline: :ok_hand: Ping me when ready and I'll merge if green.

jiayi: :+1:
